reserveReview.rationale: Rechecked 2026-07-22: Pleasing Gold materials define one PGOLD as one fine troy ounce of 99.99% LBMA-standard physical gold and describe KYC-gated physical redemption. The terms state that token supply is intended to match vaulted metal held with qualified custodians, but the issuer does not publish a current bar list, gold quantity reconciliation, named custodian, or dated independent reserve report. The published audit page concerns smart-contract security rather than reserve assurance.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pleasing Gold product and token-feature disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The physical-gold reserve category is identified, but current reserve quantities, independent assurance, custody provider, segregation, and redemption liquidity are not independently evidenced.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Physical gold is an exogenous commodity reserve rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.
